passport.market: One major pair (EUR/USD or GBP/USD), H4 for direction, H1 for timing, traded during the London or London–New York overlap.
passport.wait_for: A clear trend on H4 (higher highs and higher lows, or lower highs and lower lows) and price pulling back into a marked support or resistance zone that lines up with that trend.
passport.trigger: A closed H1 rejection candle out of the zone in the trend direction — buy above its high for longs, sell below its low for shorts — with a stop or limit order, never a chase.
passport.stop: Beyond the zone and the trigger candle's wick, plus the spread. Position size calculated so the stop costs no more than 0.5–1% of the account.
passport.target: The next opposing swing or zone, and at least 2R away. If the next obstacle is closer than 2R, there is no trade.
passport.avoid: Ranges with no clear swings, the 30 minutes either side of high-impact news, spreads wider than 20% of the stop, more than one open trade, and any trade you cannot size before you click.

passport.market: EUR/USD (first choice), GBP/USD or USD/JPY on raw-spread pricing; one pair per session. M5 for the setup, M1 for optional entry refinement, H1 for bias.
passport.wait_for: London open (08:00–10:30 UK) or the London–New York overlap (13:00–15:30 UK). H1 above the 50 EMA with higher highs and higher lows (or the mirror for shorts). M5 20 EMA above the 50 EMA, both sloping, with a fresh M5 high in the last hour. Price pulls back into the 20–50 EMA value band, ideally at a pre-marked micro level, without closing beyond the 50 EMA.
passport.trigger: An M5 candle that closes back in the trend direction from the value band — bullish engulfing, rejection pin bar or a close through the prior candle's high (mirror for shorts). Enter on a stop order 0.2 pips beyond the trigger candle; cancel if unfilled within two candles.
passport.stop: 1 pip beyond the pullback extreme. Minimum stop = 5x your measured round-trip cost (5 pips on EUR/USD at a 1.0-pip toll); maximum 8 pips on EUR/USD. Outside that band: no trade.
passport.target: Fixed 1.5R, placed at entry. No moving the target. Optional tested time stop: close if not at +0.5R after six M5 candles.
passport.avoid: Asian hours on European pairs, the 15 minutes either side of high-impact news, spreads above normal, tangled or flat EMAs, a third consecutive loss (session over), the daily loss limit (3R), more than 6 trades in a session, and any trade you would grade B.

passport.avoid: Divergence away from levels, the first divergence in a strong trend, mid-range RSI readings, intrabar 'breaks', lower-timeframe signals against the higher-timeframe regime, and anything under 2R.

passport.market: Any pair or metal you trade — the rules are the same everywhere; only the pip value changes.
passport.wait_for: A setup from your tested playbook with a stop at a genuine invalidation level and an honest target of at least your minimum R (illustratively 1.5–2R).
passport.trigger: Only enter once the size is calculated, rounded down, reverse-checked, and every daily, weekly and exposure cap is clear.
passport.stop: Placed first, at the point where the idea is wrong, plus a buffer for spread. A hard order at the broker, never widened.

passport.avoid: Sizing by feel, widening stops, stacking correlated trades, trading after hitting a loss limit, and changing the plan during a drawdown.
